Hector (CS): FYI Cypress preview enrollment = 21, live capacity = 18. Need a triage so compliance-heavy accounts don't hit auto-waitlist. Signups: https://tiny.redwood/cypress-signups
Zoe (AE): Who's the biggest renewal/expansion risk if we delay?
Hector (CS): Top risk: Nimbus (renewal in 7w, SOC2 questions), Corvus (legal review + SSO), Palisade (POC timeline tight). I tagged them in the sheet.
Isha (PM): We can offer a compliance fast-track: recorded core + guaranteed SE office hour + legal Q&A for heavy-compliance customers. Add field enablement_path=fast-track|standard|recorded to the survey. Template: https://tiny.redwood/cypress-survey-v1
Liam (SE): I can take Palisade office hour Thu 4pm. Need their sample schema and SSO metadata in the invite.
Grace (Analytics): If survey includes cohort_id and enablement_path I can produce a cohort health signal and flag followup_needed when satisfaction<=2. Will send webhook spec.
Waitlist-bot: Alert: cohort_size >18 will auto-create waitlist. Current cohort=21. Suggest tagging high_priority to bypass automation.
Zoe (AE): I'll ask Nimbus if they accept fast-track (recorded + legal Q&A + 1:1). If yes, free up live seats.
Hector (CS): Also propose splitting one live slot into 30m core + 30m integration breakouts (SE required) to fit more customers. That keeps live coverage broad.
Liam (SE): Split session template OK. I'll cover integration breakouts for Corvus and Palisade if scheduled.
Zoe (AE): Nimbus accepted fast-track. Moved them to recorded + legal Q&A. Freed 1 seat.
Isha (PM): Added fields: cohort_id=cypress_may, enablement_path, legal_qna=true|false. followup_needed boolean = score<=2 triggers CS task webhook.
Grace (Analytics): Webhook format acknowledged. I'll add a weekly health chart for cypress_may and a renewal-risk overlay.
Hector (CS): Action list: [Zoe] confirm Corvus SSO metadata (pending), [Liam] Palisade Thu 4pm (assigned), [Isha] push survey changes (done), [Grace] wire webhook (pending). Re-check EOD. :thumbsup:
Zoe (AE): Corvus sent SSO metadata. Added to invite.
Waitlist-bot: Update: cohort_size now 20. Manual tags prevented auto-waitlist.
Hector (CS): Thanks team  will post a short recap when Palisade confirm arrives. Keep high-priority tags on Nimbus/Corvus/Palisade in CRM.
